canada.summary: Several people were taken to hospital after a multi-vehicle crash in Winnipeg's West End area on Saturday morning, police say.

canada.title: Woman killed in early-morning collision on Highway 1 in Langley, B.C., RCMP say
canada.summary: RCMP are investigating a collision on Highway 1 in Langley, B.C., early Saturday in which a woman was killed.

canada.title: B.C. ISIS bride says it was 'a terrible mistake' moving to war-torn Syria to live with husband
canada.summary: In 2015, Kimberly Polman was unemployed and living in low-income housing in British Columbia when she made a life-changing decision — she would move to war-torn Syria and join her husband in the Islamic State terrorist organization.

canada.title: Single gas turbine sufficient for Manitoba Hydro's planned generating plant expansion: PUB
canada.summary: The Public Utility Board is advising Manitoba Hydro to install a single gas turbine, rather than three as originally proposed, at a major facility the Crown corporation wants to build in Brandon — a recommendation welcomed by critics of the utility's $3-billion proposal.

canada.title: A ‘tragic scene’: 5 people, including 3 children, seriously injured in Burlington house fire
canada.summary: Five people, including three children, are in hospital fighting for their lives after a residential fire broke out early this morning in Burlington.

canada.title: This independent cinema in Halifax is tapping into demand for a different kind of movie
canada.summary: Carbon Arc Cinema's artistic director Lee Anne Gillan says post-pandemic hunger for communal filmgoing is fueling ticket sales in Halifax.

canada.title: New AI app helps Montreal woman with ALS get her voice back
canada.summary: Anne-Marie Poirier has amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, or ALS, a progressive neurological disease that has robbed her of her ability to speak and affected her ability to swallow. But a new artificial intelligence tool has brought a simulated version of her voice back into the lives of her loved ones, reinvigorating her family conversations and interactions.

canada.title: CFB Wainwright incident casts spotlight on reserve pay disparities: former bureaucrat
canada.summary: Four soldiers died and 39 others — including several reservists — were injured when a fire suddenly overtook a training area at CFB Wainwright last month.

canada.title: Montreal police use tear gas to disperse downtown student protest
canada.summary: Montreal police deployed tear gas and moved to disperse crowds Friday afternoon after a student demonstration led to clashes with officers clad in riot gear.

canada.title: Some flights in and out of Ottawa affected by U.S. ground stop
canada.summary: An order from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) grounding all departing flights has affected some arrivals and departures at the Ottawa International Airport.

canada.title: Can N.L. build its own ships? Industry players say yes, as province studies capacity
canada.summary: A ferry hasn't been built in Newfoundland and Labrador since 2011. The province is now attempting to revive its shipbuilding industry, starting with a $110,000 assessment of the sector’s ability to construct three new vessels for the aging ferry fleet.

canada.title: Association of Canadian Archivists: Saving our Yukon stories, world digital preservation day
canada.summary: November 5 is World Digital Preservation Day and it coincides with an important milestone for Yukon Archives: the acquisition of a significant collection of Government of Yukon born-digital records. The […]

canada.title: Low eligibility rates for legal aid could be leaving some Yukoners in-between
canada.summary: To be eligible for legal aid, an individual can't make more than $27,000 per year. A private family lawyer can cost someone hundreds of dollars per hour. Compounding the problem could be the territory’s lawyer shortage, which is hitting family law particularly hard.

canada.title: Healing through horses: Sask. program builds confidence, connection and reconciliation
canada.summary: Mistatim Healing is giving students at Cut Knife Community School an opportunity to overcome anxiety. Teachers are already noticing positive changes.

canada.title: Wollaston Lake, Sask., celebrates final stage of all-season highway project
canada.summary: Wollaston Lake and Hatchet Lake Denesuline First Nation will have improved access to the south and to other northern communities. Planning and design work for Highway 995 began in 2004.

canada.title: Rise in costs cause disability non-profit to close its doors after 14 years
canada.summary: The John Wood Foundation is a charity that raises funds to support disabled New Brunswickers. It announced they will close for good after 14 years because of increasing operational costs.

canada.title: Remaining 3 N.S. health zones switch to One Person One Record today
canada.summary: One Person One Record launched at the IWK Health Centre last December and in the central health zone in May. Now the system goes live in the western, eastern and northern health zones.
